description: Apex Institute's flagship national level technical extravaganza featuring keynote speeches, bot combat, project exhibitions, and coding face-offs.
organizer: Technical Affairs Council & IEEE Student Branch
eligibility: All Engineering, Diploma, and Science students with valid College ID.
rules:
1. College ID card is mandatory.
2. Teams must report 30 mins prior to the event.
3. Misconduct leads to immediate disqualification.
4. Registration is free for internal students.

description: An intense 36-hour hackathon to build disruptive software and hardware prototypes in AI/ML, Web3, FinTech, and Smart Healthcare.
organizer: ACM Student Chapter & Google Developer Groups on Campus
eligibility: Open to all 2nd, 3rd, and 4th-year students (teams of 2-4).
rules:
1. All code must be written during the hackathon period.
2. Open-source libraries and APIs are allowed with attribution.
3. Final live pitch and demo to industry jury.

eventName: Modern Full-Stack Web Development Hands-on Workshop
description: Master Next.js, Node.js, REST APIs, and Cloud Deployment in this comprehensive 2-day hands-on masterclass led by top industry software architects.
eligibility: Basic knowledge of HTML/CSS and JavaScript recommended.
rules:
1. Bring your own laptop with Node.js LTS and VS Code pre-installed.
2. Certificates awarded upon completing the capstone project.

description: Three days of music, dance, theater, street plays, fashion shows, stand-up comedy, and celebrity musical nights celebrating artistic youth culture.
eligibility: Open to all bona fide college students across India.
rules:
1. Strict anti-ragging and zero tolerance for substance use.
2. Security wristbands required for amphitheatre access.
3. Pre-registration necessary for solo and group events.

eventName: Apex Annual Sports Meet & Athletics Championship 2026
description: Inter-departmental and inter-college tournament featuring Football, Cricket, Badminton, Volleyball, 100m/400m Track, and Chess.
organizer: Department of Physical Education & Sports Club
eligibility: Physical fitness clearance and college sports registration ID.
rules:
1. Standard sports kit and non-marking shoes for indoor arena.
2. Referee decisions are final and binding.

eventName: Generative AI & Cloud Architecture National Seminar
description: Deep-dive seminar on Transformer architectures, Large Language Models (LLMs), RAG pipelines, and enterprise cloud deployment with AWS & Google Cloud experts.
organizer: AI Research Group & Department of CSE
eligibility: Faculty members, research scholars, and UG/PG students.
rules:
1. Attendees must maintain decorum during Q&A.
2. Digital participation certificate provided via email.

eventName: InnovateX – State Level Engineering Project Expo
description: Grand project demonstration showcasing hardware inventions, robotics, IoT, EV designs, and software prototypes evaluated by industry CTOs and venture capitalists.
venue: Campus Convention Center Hall A & B
eligibility: Final year and pre-final year engineering capstone project teams.
rules:
1. Working prototype demonstration is mandatory.
2. Poster presentation in standard A1 format.
3. Cash prizes for Top 3 innovations.

eventName: Drishti – National Campus Photography & Short Film Contest
description: Theme-based photography and micro-film competition capturing campus life, urban heritage, wildlife, and monochrome storytelling.
eligibility: Open to all amateur and professional student photographers.
rules:
1. Original EXIF metadata must be intact.
2. No excessive AI generation or synthetic modifications.
3. High-resolution raw submissions via portal.
